ValidationRule.description: This validation rule ensures that Sales agreement status cannot be moved from Pending with Customer to Draft or Approved.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( NOT($Setup.PMC_ProcessSwitches__c.PMC_BypassValidationRule__c), ISCHANGED( Status ), ISPICKVAL(PRIORVALUE(Status),'Pending with Customer'), OR( ISPICKVAL( Status , 'Draft'), ISPICKVAL( Status , 'Archived') ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: This agreement has already been approved, therefore it cannot be moved to Draft or Archived. Please amend the new Sales Agreement if modifications are needed.
